images.prompt:
Edit the supplied original photograph into one finished artwork. Use this image as the real visual reference. Vertical 4:5 output, at least 1024x1280 pixels.
Observed input: One adult woman with dark curly brown hair gathered low wears a sage green collarless blouse. She looks toward the left with a calm expression and holds three pale pink tulips at chest level in both hands, right hand above left around the green stems. Her upper body fills the portrait against a warm beige wall, with soft window light and shadow on the left.
Preserve: Preserve observed face angle, hairstyle, gestures and held objects; confine new ornamental curves to background and collar areas. Source subject count, recognizable identity, essential openings and connected anatomy. The complete main subject within the original frame and the intended relative placement of objects.
medium: A decorative portrait organized by flowing botanical curves, restrained flat color and fine continuous outlines.
composition: Follow the source head angle and shoulders; grow curved ornamental bands only through existing background space.
texture: Use clean tapering ink contours, matte painted interiors and subtle lithographic paper grain.
palette: Use restrained ivory and plant-toned accents while retaining identifying hair and clothing color relationships from the source.
lighting: Flatten photographic shading into a few broad value shapes without shiny skin or heavy dimensional modeling.
detail: Derive ornament from observed forms; do not add props, titles, face-covering halos or recognizable franchise symbols.
finish: Deliver one finished image at the input aspect ratio, without comparison panels, unrequested text, logos, signatures or watermarks.
Avoid: Invented people, duplicate main subjects, extra limbs, disconnected anatomy or accidental clipping. Unrequested titles, logos, signatures, watermarks, fabricated labels or before-and-after panels. A generic filter without the requested medium-specific physical or optical mechanism.

review.reason: Source face angle, low curly hairstyle, sage blouse and three held tulips remain recognizable, with coherent two-hand placement. Tapered ink contours, matte value planes and flowing plant-derived background arabesques create the intended ornamental language; new ornament is confined to permitted background and collar areas.
